summary: The Duo cost log had no way to be totalled by flow. scripts/cost_summary.py reads the table of docs/submission/cost-log.md, groups the rows by What ran and sums credits (Delta), pipelines, job minutes, job seconds and retries. A cell that is not a number (human, null, empty) adds nothing and is counted as missing, never as zero. Prints a markdown table or JSON; exit 2 on a missing file or a file without the table. Sums use Decimal so decimals add exactly. 33 tests in tests/tooling/test_cost_summary.py, written first.
